en: Black-and-white postcard showing a modernist school complex in a hilly, rural landscape. The main building has long rows of windows and a flat roof, with additional block-like wings nearby. The foreground is filled with trees and cultivated land, and low mountains or large hills rise in the background. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard layout with Hungarian text indicating the view of the general school in the Mecsekalja district of Pécs, and publisher/pricing information.
